description.name: Attach Lightning with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Lightning Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Lightning 3

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shantotto
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Salvation Scythe (0~2), removed after using Salvation Scythe two times

description.name: Salvation Scythe Ability Tracker
description.text: Increases Salvation Scythe level by 1 after using 5 or 8 Lightning abilities during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shantotto]

description.name: Salvation Scythe Level
description.text: Keeps track of Salvation Scythe level (0~2), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Shantotto]
